tools.name: humanitix_list_events
tools.description: List your events, newest first, with dates, ticket types, pricing and capacity. Filter to upcoming events or events changed since a date. Paged (total/page/pageSize in the response). Humanitix: GET /v1/events.

tools.name: humanitix_get_event
tools.description: Fetch one event: name, description, URL, dates (each date's _id is the event_date_id other tools take), ticket types, packaged tickets, pricing, location, capacity and publish state. Humanitix: GET /v1/events/{eventId}.

tools.name: humanitix_get_check_in_count
tools.description: How many attendees have checked in for one date of an event, in total and per ticket type (ticket types with sales only, most check-ins first). BETA endpoint. Humanitix: GET /v1/events/{eventId}/check-in-count.

tools.name: humanitix_list_orders
tools.description: List the orders for an event (optionally one date of it): buyer name/email, financial status, totals, discounts, payment type and sales channel. Paged. Humanitix: GET /v1/events/{eventId}/orders.

tools.name: humanitix_get_order
tools.description: Fetch one order of an event, with its totals breakdown, answers to checkout questions and buyer details. Humanitix: GET /v1/events/{eventId}/orders/{orderId}.

tools.name: humanitix_list_tickets
tools.description: List the tickets (attendees) for an event, optionally one date of it and complete or cancelled only: attendee name, ticket type, price, check-in state and seating. Paged. Humanitix: GET /v1/events/{eventId}/tickets.

tools.name: humanitix_get_ticket
tools.description: Fetch one ticket of an event, including its check-in history and any swap history. Humanitix: GET /v1/events/{eventId}/tickets/{ticketId}.

tools.name: humanitix_list_tags
tools.description: List the tags you use to group events (events carry them in tagIds). Paged. Humanitix: GET /v1/tags.

tools.name: humanitix_get_tag
tools.description: Fetch one tag by id. Humanitix: GET /v1/tags/{tagId}.

tools.name: humanitix_list_global_events
tools.description: List public events from across the whole Humanitix platform, filterable by type, category and subcategory. Requires a special permission Humanitix activates on your account (403 otherwise). Paged. Humanitix: GET /v1/global/events.

tools.name: humanitix_list_global_event_dates
tools.description: List individual event dates from across the platform — one row per date — with the public on-sale status of every ticket type. Requires a special permission Humanitix activates on your account (403 otherwise). Paged. Humanitix: GET /v1/global/event-dates.

tools.name: humanitix_check_in_ticket
tools.description: Mark a ticket as checked in at the door. Returns any scanning messages configured for that ticket. Undo with humanitix_check_out_ticket. Humanitix: POST /v1/events/{eventId}/tickets/{ticketId}/check-in.

tools.name: humanitix_check_out_ticket
tools.description: Mark a checked-in ticket as checked out (e.g. to undo a mistaken check-in or track re-entry). Humanitix: POST /v1/events/{eventId}/tickets/{ticketId}/check-out.

tools.name: humanitix_create_event
tools.description: Create a base event (name, description, timezone, one or more date ranges, location, keywords, classification). Ticket types are then set up in the Humanitix console. Requires a special permission Humanitix activates on your account (403 otherwise). Humanitix: POST /v1/events.

tools.name: humanitix_update_event
tools.description: Update an event's name, description, timezone, location, keywords or classification, and add or reschedule dates (date operations CREATE and UPDATE; deleting dates is not exposed). Only fields you pass are sent. Requires a special permission Humanitix activates on your account (403 otherwise). Human

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: humanitix_list_events, humanitix_get_event, humanitix_get_check_in_count, humanitix_list_orders, humanitix_list_tickets, humanitix_get_ticket, humanitix_list_global_event_dates, humanitix_check_in_ticket, humanitix_check_out_ticket · Public sink: humanitix_get_event, humanitix_list_orders, humanitix_check_in_ticket, humanitix_check_out_ticket, humanitix_create_event.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: humanitix_list_events, humanitix_get_event, humanitix_get_check_in_count, humanitix_list_orders, humanitix_list_tickets, humanitix_get_ticket, humanitix_list_global_event_dates, humanitix_check_in_ticket, humanitix_check_out_ticket · Public sink: humanitix_get_event, humanitix_list_orders, humanitix_check_in_ticket, humanitix_check_out_ticket, humanitix_create_event

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
